question: Does serum cortisol add information about Long COVID beyond draw time, age, sex and BMI?
rule: adds information only if Delta CI low > 0 AND cortisol-only permutation p < 0.05
caveat: Case-control by recruitment channel (LC clinics vs advertisement); one blood draw per person; cortisol is diurnal (draw time adjusted linearly) and measured on a multiplex immunoassay; values and labels are the authors' released rows, so this re-analyses the same data, it is not an independent replication.
